items.author: Musk
items.text: After a record-setting IPO last month, SpaceX’s honeymoon is over. Elon Musk has shed hundreds of billions in wealth, demoting him from trillionaire status, and SpaceX’s stock price has been cut practically in half.
items.summary_cn: SpaceX股价较IPO高点近乎腰斩，Musk跌出万亿美元俱乐部，对kcn持有的SPCX/SPCH构成显著利空信号。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk’s SpaceX tumbles back to Earth, dragging Tesla stock down with it
items.summary_cn: SpaceX估值回调拖累Tesla股价下行，Musk帝国双线承压，间接利空kcn持有的SpaceX相关标的。

items.author: Musk
items.text: After Losing 40% Of His Net Worth In A Month, Elon Musk Attempts To Raise $4 Billion For Another Company
items.summary_cn: Musk身价缩水背景下仍为另一家公司（疑为xAI）寻求40亿美元融资，资本运作密集，间接反映Musk系流动性紧张。

items.author: Musk
items.summary_cn: Musk身价跌破7000亿美元关口，财富回撤持续，对SpaceX相关持仓形成估值压制氛围。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk says Tesla Semi self-driving is a year away, so truckers are safe
items.summary_cn: Musk表示Tesla Semi自动驾驶距商用约一年，卡车司机短期饭碗保住了，利好Tesla干线物流叙事。

items.text: Congratulations to Alexander Kolodin for his great win in Arizona’s race for Secretary of State. He is tough, smart, and a proven winner. He was with me in my big Presidential Win. We’ll do a fantastic Trump Rally to make sure he WINS. Alexander Kolodin has my complete and total Endorsement. He will never let you down! President Donald J.  Trump
